mapper.select: SELECT hpdp.*, (SELECT scvb.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scb.code = 'HLS500_PRODUCT_PARA' AND scb.code_id = scvb.code_id AND scvb.value = hpdp.product_para) AS product_para_display FROM hls_product_definition_para hpdp WHERE hpdp.definition_id = #{definitionId} ORDER BY hpdp.product_para ASC

select pq.quotation_id, hpdp.product_para_id, hpdp.definition_id, hpdp.product_para, hpdp.description, hpdp.default_value, hpdp.value_from, hpdp.value_to, (select s.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.code = 'HLS500_PRODUCT_PARA' and s.code_value = hpdp.product_para) meaning from hls_product_definition_para hpdp, prj_quotation pq where pq.plan_id = hpdp.definition_id and hpdp.enabled_flag = 'Y' and pq.quotation_id = #{quotationId}

select pq.quotation_id, hpdp.product_para_id, hpdp.definition_id, hpdp.product_para, hpdp.description, hpdp.default_value, hpdp.value_from, hpdp.value_to from hls_product_definition_para hpdp, prj_quotation pq where pq.plan_id = hpdp.definition_id and hpdp.enabled_flag = 'Y' and pq.quotation_id = #{quotationId} and hpdp.product_para not in ('IRR','DEPOSIT_RATIO','DOWN_PAYMENT_RATIO')

select pq.quotation_id, hpdp.product_para_id, hpdp.definition_id, hpdp.product_para, hpdp.description, hpdp.default_value, hpdp.value_from, hpdp.value_to from hls_product_definition_para hpdp, prj_quotation pq where pq.plan_id = hpdp.definition_id and hpdp.enabled_flag = 'Y' and pq.quotation_id = #{quotationId} and hpdp.product_para = 'IRR'

select hpd.exempt_penalty_int grace_flag, hpd.int_rate_calc_flag, hpd.lease_charge_discount_rule, hpd.rental_discount_times, NVL(hpd.RESIDUAL_PRICE_TYPE,1) residual_price_type, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = hpd.int_rate_calc_flag) int_rate_calc_flag_n, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'CHARGE_DISCOUNT_RULE' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = hpd.lease_charge_discount_rule) lease_charge_discount_rule_n, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'DISCOUNT_TIMES' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = hpd.rental_discount_times) rental_discount_times_n, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE = 'EXEMPT_PENALTY_INT' and s.code_value = hpd.exempt_penalty_int) grace_flag_n, hpd.annual_pay_times, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE = 'HLS500_ANNUAL_PAY_TIMES' and s.code_value = to_char(hpd.annual_pay_times)) annual_pay_times_n, hpd.repay_flag, hpd.service_fee_repay_flag, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and s.code_value = hpd.repay_flag) repay_flag_n, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and s.code_value = hpd.service_fee_repay_flag) service_fee_repay_flag_n, hpd.step_quotation_flag, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and s.code_value = hpd.step_quotation_flag) step_quotation_flag_n, hpd.residual_value_received, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE = 'RESIDUAL_VALUE_RECEIVED' and s.code_value = hpd.residual_value_received) residual_value_received_n, hpd.repay_mode, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE = 'REPAY_MODE' and s.code_value = hpd.repay_mode) repay_mode_n, hpd.simple_compound_type, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE = 'SIMPLE_COMPOUND_TYPE' and s.code_value = hpd.simple_compound_type) simple_compound_type_n from hls_product_definition hpd, prj_quotation pq where pq.plan_id = hpd.definition_id and hpd.enabled_flag = 'Y' and pq.quotation_id = #{quotationId}
